verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of markdown doc links. Individual pages are served as .md files whose headers tell agents to fetch the complete index from llms.txt, which shows deliberately agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs.
